title: GameHub Production Finishing
summary: Complete, polish, bug-fix, and production-ready the GameHub multi-game platform with comprehensive UI testing, security review, and deployment preparation
nonGoals: Adding new games beyond the existing 14
Major architectural refactors unless blocking production
qualityGates: All critical game flows have Playwright UI tests
No blocking security vulnerabilities in socket/room handling
Mobile-responsive for all core screens (lobby, game rooms)
Hub service passes all existing + new tests
Web service passes all existing + new tests
Core games (Catan, UNO, Wordle, Chess) fully tested end-to-end

stories.title: Set up Playwright UI testing infrastructure
stories.description: Add Playwright to services/web with test helpers for common game flows (join room, start game, take turn). Configure for both desktop and mobile viewports. Create reusable page objects for lobby, game room, and player components.
acceptanceCriteria: Playwright installed and configured in services/web
Test helpers created for: joining room, starting game, sending socket events
Page objects created for: HubHome, GameLobby, GameRoom
Can run tests headless and headed modes
Mobile viewport tests configured (375x667)

stories.title: Add Playwright tests for Catan game flow
stories.description: Create end-to-end tests for Catan covering: room creation, player joining, game start, dice roll, resource collection, building (settlement/road), trading, and victory. Use test helpers from FIN-001.
acceptanceCriteria: Test covers full game initialization
Test validates dice rolls and resource distribution
Test verifies building placement and validation
Test checks victory point calculation
Test handles player disconnection gracefully

stories.title: Add Playwright tests for UNO game flow
stories.description: Create end-to-end tests for UNO covering: room setup, game start, card playing (number/color match), special cards (skip, reverse, draw2/draw4), color choice, UNO call, and win detection.
acceptanceCriteria: Test covers full game from join to win
Test validates playable card logic
Test verifies special card behaviors (draw, skip, reverse)
Test checks UNO call penalty
Test confirms winner detection and scoring

stories.title: Add Playwright tests for Wordle daily flow
stories.description: Create UI tests for Wordle daily mode covering: start game with name, submit guesses, visual feedback (green/yellow/gray tiles), win/lose outcomes, and leaderboard display.
acceptanceCriteria: Test covers name entry and game start
Test validates guess submission and feedback
Test checks win outcome (6 guesses or less)
Test checks lose outcome (6 failed guesses)
Test verifies leaderboard updates

stories.title: Mobile responsiveness review and fixes
stories.description: Review all core screens (HubHome, GameLobby, game rooms for Catan/UNO/Wordle/Chess) on mobile viewports. Fix layout issues, ensure buttons are tappable, and improve touch interactions. Test on 375x667 (iPhone SE) and 360x640 (Android).
acceptanceCriteria: HubHome renders correctly on mobile
Game lobbies are usable on mobile (join, start game)
Game boards scale appropriately (Catan board, UNO cards)
Buttons are min 44x44px for touch targets
No horizontal scroll on mobile viewports
stories.statusNote: Shipped in commit 7003ae57 (mobile responsiveness). Status field had drifted.

stories.title: Security review: Socket authentication and room authorization
stories.description: Audit services/hub socket handling for authentication weaknesses, room authorization bypasses, and input validation gaps. Review: socket connection auth, room join permissions, player actions authorization, and admin commands.
acceptanceCriteria: Socket connections validate player identity
Room join requests check permissions (public/private rooms)
Player actions verify room membership and turn order
Admin commands (kick, start game) verify host permissions
Input validation prevents injection attacks
No sensitive data leaks in error messages
stories.statusNote: Validation and rate limiting landed; host authorization landed. Session-token auth reverted as broken and unnecessary for a LAN/Tailscale deployment - see services/hub/SECURITY_NOTES.md. Re-scoped: identity stays client-supplied.

stories.title: Bug fix: Room synchronization on player disconnect
stories.description: Fix race conditions when players disconnect during active games. Ensure room state updates correctly, other players are notified, and game can continue or end gracefully. Test with Catan (mid-turn disconnect) and UNO (disconnect before UNO call).
acceptanceCriteria: Player disconnect removes player from room.players
Other players receive 'player-left' event
Active games handle disconnects without crashing
Turn progression skips disconnected players
Game ends if too few players remain
stories.statusNote: Disconnect removal landed for all games incl. UNO. Still needs tests covering mid-turn disconnect per game.

stories.title: Bug fix: Catan resource distribution edge cases
stories.description: Fix edge cases in Catan resource distribution: 7-roll discard validation, bank trade ratio enforcement, monopoly card resource transfer, and year-of-plenty card validation. Add comprehensive unit tests.
acceptanceCriteria: 7-roll discard only triggers if player has >7 resources
Bank trades validate 4:1 or 3:1 (port) ratios
Monopoly transfers all specified resources from all players
Year-of-plenty validates requested resources exist in bank
Unit tests cover all edge cases

stories.title: Performance: Load test room management
stories.description: Create load tests for room management: 100 concurrent rooms, 1000+ total players, rapid join/leave cycles. Identify bottlenecks in Redis operations, socket broadcasts, and room state updates. Optimize if needed.
acceptanceCriteria: Load test script created (Node.js or Artillery)
Test validates 100 concurrent rooms with 4 players each
Test validates 1000+ socket connections
Response times documented for room operations
Bottlenecks identified and prioritized
stories.statusNote: Cut 2026-09-23: LAN/Tailscale family deployment does not face 100 concurrent rooms or 1000+ players.

stories.title: Polish: Improve lobby UX and game start flow
stories.description: Enhance lobby experience: show player avatars/names clearly, add ready-up mechanism, show game type icons, improve room code display, add copy-to-clipboard for room codes, and smoother transitions to game screens.
acceptanceCriteria: Player list shows names clearly with visual indicators
Ready-up button added for players (host can start when all ready)
Game type icons/badges visible in lobby
Room code displayed prominently with copy button
Transition to game screen has loading indicator
Mobile-friendly layout

stories.title: Documentation: Deployment guide and README
stories.description: Create comprehensive documentation covering: local development setup, environment variables, Redis configuration, production deployment (Docker/cloud platforms), monitoring setup, and troubleshooting common issues.
acceptanceCriteria: README.md includes quick start for developers
DEPLOYMENT.md covers production setup
Environment variables documented (hub + web)
Redis setup instructions provided
Docker Compose configuration included
Troubleshooting section for common issues

stories.title: Production readiness: Environment configs and health checks
stories.description: Add production environment configurations, health check endpoints for hub service, graceful shutdown handling, and error monitoring setup (Sentry or similar). Ensure CORS is properly configured for production domains.
acceptanceCriteria: Environment-specific configs (dev, staging, prod)
Health check endpoint: GET /health returns 200 OK
Graceful shutdown closes socket connections properly
CORS configured for production domain
Error monitoring configured (console.error in dev, Sentry in prod)
Logging strategy documented
stories.statusNote: Keep health check and graceful shutdown. Sentry/error monitoring cut for a LAN deployment.

stories.title: Code quality: ESLint and formatting consistency
stories.description: Ensure consistent code formatting across hub and web services. Add ESLint rules, Prettier config, and pre-commit hooks. Fix existing linting issues (warnings only, don't block).
acceptanceCriteria: ESLint configured for hub (JavaScript) and web (TypeScript)
Prettier config added and applied to all files
Pre-commit hook runs linter (warn only, don't block)
Existing linting warnings fixed or suppressed with comments
Formatting consistent across codebase

stories.title: Accessibility: A11y review for lobby and game screens
stories.description: Review accessibility for HubHome, GameLobby, and core game screens. Add ARIA labels, keyboard navigation support, focus indicators, and screen reader announcements for game events.
acceptanceCriteria: All interactive elements have ARIA labels
Keyboard navigation works for lobby and game actions
Focus indicators visible on all focusable elements
Screen reader announcements for key events (game start, turn change, win)
Color contrast meets WCAG AA standards
Automated a11y tests added (jest-axe or playwright-axe)

stories.title: Integration: CI/CD pipeline setup
stories.description: Set up GitHub Actions for continuous integration: run tests on push, lint checks, type checking (web service), and automated deployment preview. Configure for monorepo structure (hub + web).
acceptanceCriteria: GitHub Actions workflow runs on push/PR
Hub tests run in CI (npm test)
Web tests run in CI (npm test)
TypeScript type checking runs for web service
ESLint runs for both services
Deployment preview available for PRs (Vercel/Netlify)
stories.statusNote: CI runs hub unit + integration tests, web unit tests + build, and an image asset check. Each check verified to fail against the bug it guards. Playwright e2e deliberately left out of CI: it needs browser downloads and a full stack, and the hub smoke test covers the same ground more cheaply.

notes: Use multi-agent ralph for complexity 6+ stories
Use simple ralph for FIN-011, FIN-013 (documentation/formatting)
Parallel execution in polish/security/quality phases for speed
UI tests (FIN-002 to FIN-004) can run in parallel after FIN-001
Security review (FIN-006) should block production deployment
2026-09-23 re-scope: deployment target is LAN/Tailscale family use, not public internet. Threat and load model narrowed accordingly; see services/hub/SECURITY_NOTES.md.
Verify claims by running the command. The earlier loop filed passing-test reports for suites that never terminated.
